recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一顆嗜中性球的細胞質內可見數顆大而不規則、灰紫色的包涵顆粒，明顯大於正常顆粒，是 Chediak-Higashi 症候群的巨大顆粒。
features: Mature neutrophil with a band-to-segmented, C-shaped nucleus
Several large, irregular gray-purple cytoplasmic inclusions (giant granules)
Remaining cytoplasm pale with few normal granules
Background red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis
Isolated leukocyte in field, suggesting low neutrophil count (not quantifiable here)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells and a single neutrophil. The neutrophil contains several coarse, irregular gray-purple cytoplasmic inclusions that are much larger than normal specific or toxic granules. No Döhle bodies or vacuolation are evident. Findings are consistent with the giant granules of Chediak-Higashi syndrome.

ddx.vs: Döhle and May-Hegglin inclusions are pale blue, peripheral, spindle-shaped and associated with giant platelets rather than purple granular inclusions.
Toxic granules are fine, dark and evenly distributed, not few large irregular bodies.
Seen in AML/MDS with accompanying dysplasia or blasts, whereas CHS is congenital with albinism.
